hooks.command: bash -lc 'r=$(cd .. 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 0; payload=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$payload" ] || exit 0; cmd=$(printf "%s" "$payload" | jq -r ".toolCall.args.CommandLine // empty" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$cmd" ] || exit 0; "$r/bin/fm-arm-pretool-check.sh" --command "$cmd"'

bash -lc 'r=$(cd .. 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 0; payload=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$payload" ] || exit 0; cmd=$(printf "%s" "$payload" | jq -r ".toolCall.args.CommandLine // empty" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$cmd" ] || exit 0; "$r/bin/fm-cd-pretool-check.sh" --command "$cmd"'

bash -lc 'r=$(cd .. 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 0; payload=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$payload" ] || exit 0; tool=$(printf "%s" "$payload" | jq -r ".toolCall.name // empty" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$tool" ] || exit 0; "$r/bin/fm-subagent-pretool-check.sh" --tool "$tool"'
